caption: The video captures a close-up of a clear glass tumbler filled with a dark amber-red carbonated drink, with ice cubes protruding above the rim against a near-black, backlit background. The glass and ice remain in essentially the same position, while the liquid surface height and cube arrangement stay unchanged. Carbonation bubbles keep forming, cling to the ice faces and inner glass wall, and rise through the glowing liquid. Their distribution shifts from moment to moment, creating moving sparkles and subtle changes in the clinging bubbles and glossy surfaces on the cubes. Specular highlights on the ice move slightly as the bubbles and surfaces change, not as the cubes themselves translate. Thin vertical bright streaks appear intermittently near the top edge of the frame, without a visible splash or point of impact. The camera viewpoint is stationary, so the rim, background, and overall composition remain constant. The visible process is ongoing fizzing and bubble motion within a full glass.
relations: Carbonation bubbles form and rise through the liquid while the ice cubes and liquid surface height remain stationary.
Bubbles cling to the ice and glass wall, causing subtle shifts in glossy surfaces and specular highlights.
Thin vertical bright streaks appear intermittently near the top edge without visible splashes or point of impact.
